summary: Binary prediction of whether a protein is soluble when expressed, from sequence alone.
what_it_measures: Each protein carries a 0/1 label for insoluble vs. soluble expression. The labels trace to the DeepSol resource (E. coli expression solubility), distributed via the `proteinea/solubility` dataset.
assay_method: Experimental solubility upon heterologous (E. coli) expression, aggregated from prior solubility datasets; the original DeepSol split excludes test sequences ≥30% identical to training.
provenance: Downloaded from the ProteinEA Hugging Face dataset; the fluorescence sibling dataset is intentionally excluded from this enzyme benchmark.
when_to_use: A protein-level classification probe of how well an embedding captures expressibility/solubility determinants; useful for expression-risk screening.
caveats: Solubility labels are noisy and host/condition dependent (largely E. coli); not enzyme-specific, so it tests general representation quality rather than catalysis.

citations.title: DeepSol: a deep learning framework for sequence-based protein solubility prediction
